meta.look: Studio (data-look=studio) — the staff workspace values; the member app shares the materials

tokens.name: brand-deepBlue
tokens.usage: The brand blue. The menu (blue plaster), heroes, the script wordmark on light grounds. Cream or yellow text on it.

tokens.name: brand-midBlue
tokens.usage: River blue. Focus rings, the river tone, accents. Never body text on paper (3.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: Sun yellow. Highlights, pricing badges, the info-note edge. A marker, never a full banner.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: Cream. Wordmark on deep blue, text on blue heroes.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Ink. Headings and the primary pill in the Studio look.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Sand. The ground behind frames on the website and hub.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Paper white. Cards in the Studio look, text on ink pills.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Under the limestone photograph (84% veil) in light; under procedural stone in dark.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Paper: cards, tables, panels, secondary buttons and chips. Carries the grain and linen.

tokens.name: color-surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised paper: drawers, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: color-surface-2
tokens.usage: Soft paper one step down: notes, muted tiles, code blocks.

tokens.name: color-surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed: tracks, segmented grounds, hover of soft controls.

tokens.name: color-surface-4
tokens.usage: Photo and avatar placeholder fill.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Headings and figures on color-bg and every surface (≥ 12:1 light, ≥ 11:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body copy on color-bg and every surface (≥ 10:1).

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and hints on surfaces (≥ 6:1 light, ≥ 6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-text-faint
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and captions on color-surface and color-bg only (≥ 4.5:1 there).

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Links and brand text on surfaces.

tokens.name: color-accent-fill
tokens.usage: The primary action fill: the ink pill in light, the deep blue pill in dark. Text: color-text-on-primary.

tokens.name: color-accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of the primary pill.

tokens.name: color-text-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on color-accent-fill and on deep-blue heroes (≥ 7:1).

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Accent marks, the tonal button tint (24%), focus in light.

tokens.name: color-highlight
tokens.usage: Highlight badges and the info-note icon. Text: color-on-highlight.

tokens.name: color-on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on color-highlight (≥ 8:1).

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, dividers, the paper-pill edge.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and select borders, outline buttons.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: The 2 px focus ring, offset 2 px, on every control (≥ 3:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Paid, checked in, done. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: color-warn
tokens.usage: Waiting, almost full. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Failed, overdue, destructive actions. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Pending payment, in progress.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind drawers and dialogs.

tokens.name: tone-river-dot
tokens.usage: River class tone at full pigment: calendar dots, roster markers, bars. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: tone-sun-dot
tokens.usage: Sun class tone at full pigment: dots and markers only.

tokens.name: tone-clay-dot
tokens.usage: Clay class tone at full pigment: dots and markers only.

tokens.name: tone-moss-dot
tokens.usage: Moss class tone at full pigment: dots and markers only.

tokens.name: tone-sage-dot
tokens.usage: Sage class tone: dots and markers.

tokens.name: tone-slate-dot
tokens.usage: Slate class tone: dots and markers.

tokens.name: tone-plum-dot
tokens.usage: Plum class tone: dots and markers.

tokens.name: tone-river-wash
tokens.usage: Limewash fill for large tiles (KPI 1, first quick tile, hub tiles). Text #0e1721 (stat ink).

tokens.name: tone-sun-wash
tokens.usage: Limewash fill for large tiles (KPI 2). Text #0e1721.

tokens.name: tone-clay-wash
tokens.usage: Limewash fill for large tiles (KPI 3). Text #0e1721.

tokens.name: tone-moss-wash
tokens.usage: Limewash fill for large tiles (KPI 4). Text #0e1721 (ink, no longer white).

tokens.name: tone-sage-wash
tokens.usage: Limewash fill when a sage class gets a tile.

tokens.name: tone-slate-wash
tokens.usage: Limewash fill when a slate class gets a tile.

tokens.name: tone-plum-wash
tokens.usage: Limewash fill when a plum class gets a tile.

tokens.name: stat-ink
tokens.usage: Text on every tone wash, both themes (6.5–11.8:1).

families.editorial: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Georgia, serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page h1 and greetings. One per screen.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI text, buttons, chips, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and meta. Never below 16 px from 1920 px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows over titles, in color-text-faint.

spacing.note: One 4 px scale in rem; it scales with the --ui band on large screens.

tokens.name: sp-2xs
tokens.usage: Notice title → text.

tokens.name: sp-xs
tokens.usage: stack-tight: eyebrow → heading.

tokens.name: sp-sm
tokens.usage: gap-inline and stack: icon ↔ label, rows of a small list.

tokens.name: sp-md
tokens.usage: gap-control: between buttons and chips; row padding y.

tokens.name: sp-lg
tokens.usage: card-pad on phones, gutter, grid-gap, button padding x.

tokens.name: sp-xl
tokens.usage: block: between blocks; card-pad from 768 px.

tokens.name: sp-2xl
tokens.usage: card-pad-lg from 768 px; gutter from 1280 px.

tokens.name: sp-3xl
tokens.usage: section on phones.

tokens.name: sp-4xl
tokens.usage: section from 768 px; hero on phones.

tokens.name: sp-5xl
tokens.usage: section-hero from 768 px.

tokens.name: h-ctl
tokens.usage: Minimum height and target of every control (44 px).

tokens.name: h-ctl-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons (48 px).

radius.note: Studio look shapes: generous, soft corners; pills for every control.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, code chips.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles inside cards (inner = outer − padding).

tokens.name: r-ctl
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, option tiles.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Cards, KPI tiles, notices.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Heroes, drawers, the hub tiles.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Feature bands.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, avatars.

shadow.note: Studio look: paper lies almost flat; controls are tactile pills; heroes are stone.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Drawers, menus, hovered interactive cards.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, unselected chips and option tiles at rest (0171).

tokens.name: shadow-pill-hover
tokens.usage: Paper pill on hover: a deeper lift.

tokens.name: shadow-pill-pressed
tokens.usage: Any pill while pressed: pushed into the paper.

tokens.name: shadow-ink-lift
tokens.usage: Primary pills, selected chips and selected option tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-stone
tokens.usage: Carved stone objects (website, hub build tile).

motion.note: Durations and easings from D-01. Every animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Press, colour and shadow changes on controls.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Card lift on hover, drawers.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panel and sheet transitions.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Progressive reveal of hub and dashboard tiles.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default easing for entrances and lifts.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Looping and two-way transitions.
